intro.h2: A Plymouth showroom where your new kitchen gets planned
paragraphs: MJ Kitchen & Bath handles kitchen remodeling in Plymouth from the first sketch to the last cabinet pull. The company began in 2009 as MJ Cabinet Designs, building custom kitchens for local builders, then added full remodeling for homeowners and took its current name in December 2019.

In June 2026 the team opened a larger showroom at 620 Ann Arbor Road, just across the street from the old one. Inside are kitchen and bath displays of Wood-Mode, Showplace and Pioneer cabinets, plus a selection center for tile, quartz and granite, flooring and hardware, so you can compare finishes side by side before you commit.

services.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Plymouth and the rooms around it

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: The team designs and installs the whole kitchen: cabinets, counters, tile, sinks, lighting and flooring. You see floor plans, elevation drawings and color renderings before work starts, and MJ's own cost guide puts same-layout kitchen remodels at $50,000 and up.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with black lower cabinets, a natural wood range hood, white island and black countertops by MJ Kitchen & Bath

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Primary baths, powder rooms, Jack-and-Jill layouts and busy family bathrooms. Popular requests include curbless walk-in showers, freestanding soaking tubs, radiant-heat floors and vanities with pull-out storage. MJ says most bath remodels are finished in 3 to 6 weeks.

image.alt: Primary bathroom with a freestanding soaking tub and a glass-enclosed shower lined in white subway tile

items.name: Semi-custom and custom cabinetry
items.blurb: Choose from Wood-Mode, crafted in Pennsylvania, Showplace from South Dakota and Pioneer from Michigan. Beyond kitchens, MJ builds cabinets for laundry rooms, mudrooms, wet bars, coffee bars and home offices, and its own carpenters install what it sells.

image.alt: Kitchen with green glass-front cabinets, a light wood island with seating and brass pendant lights

items.name: First-floor remodels
items.blurb: For bigger plans, MJ redesigns the first floor around a larger kitchen, with possible structural changes, fine custom cabinetry and new hardwood throughout. These projects start at $150,000 and often add a wet or dry bar, a powder room refresh or a new fireplace mantel.

image.alt: Open kitchen with light wood cabinets and a black island with stools that flows into a dining area

about.h2: From MJ Cabinet Designs to MJ Kitchen & Bath
about.text: Mike Jenkins spent more than 30 years in the cabinetry trade before opening MJ Cabinet Designs in 2009, building luxury custom kitchens and baths with local builders. As homeowners asked for more, the company added start-to-finish remodeling and became MJ Kitchen & Bath in December 2019. Today Mike (Owner, Cabinet Sales) and his fellow owner Matt Jenkins (Owner, Remodeling Sales) run it as a two-generation family business, with in-house designers, a project manager and lead carpenters. In the August 2026 issue of Qualified Remodeler, Matt described the goal as creating “an experience people can’t stop talking about.”

image.alt: Wood-Mode cabinetry display with a stone backsplash inside the MJ Kitchen & Bath showroom at 620 Ann Arbor Road, Plymouth

process.h2: Five steps from first call to final punch list

steps.title: Quick inquiry and ballpark
steps.text: Fill out the short inquiry form and the team calls back to review your project, give an initial ballpark estimate and outline next steps.

steps.title: In-home consultation
steps.text: A team member visits to take exact measurements, listen to your wish list and share layout ideas that make the most of the space.

steps.title: Design and proposal at the showroom
steps.text: You review floor plans, elevation drawings, a detailed scope of work and a clear written estimate with the team in the Plymouth showroom.

steps.title: Selections with an interior designer
steps.text: Pick cabinets, counters, backsplash, flooring and hardware from showroom samples, then see your choices in color renderings before anything is ordered.

steps.title: Construction and wrap-up
steps.text: MJ secures permits and orders materials, then your project manager and crew build it, clean up daily and close out a punch list.

service_area.h2: Serving Plymouth, Canton, Northville and Ann Arbor
service_area.text: MJ Kitchen & Bath works from its showroom at 620 Ann Arbor Road in Plymouth, between Main Street and Lilley Road. The team remodels kitchens and baths for homeowners in Plymouth, Canton, Northville, Ann Arbor and Livonia, along with nearby Metro Detroit communities. Not sure your street is covered? Call (734) 354-9633 or stop in. The showroom is open weekdays from 9:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Saturdays by appointment, and evening appointments are available.

faq.h2: Questions Plymouth homeowners ask before they remodel

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Plymouth?
items.a: MJ's own cost guide, based on its projects in Plymouth, Northville, Canton, Ann Arbor and Livonia, lists three levels. Same-layout remodels start at $50,000, expanded remodels with wall removal start at $100,000, and first-floor remodels start at $150,000. Final cost depends on cabinet line, layout changes, material choices and the age of the home.

items.q: How long will my kitchen or bathroom be under construction?
items.a: MJ estimates 6 weeks or more of construction for a same-layout kitchen and 8 weeks or more for larger kitchen projects, counted from the start of construction. Most bathroom remodels take 3 to 6 weeks. Design, selections and ordering are all completed before construction begins, though permits or material lead times can shift dates.

items.q: Can I see cabinets in person before I choose?
items.a: Yes. The showroom at 620 Ann Arbor Road has kitchen and bath displays of Wood-Mode, Showplace and Pioneer cabinetry, plus samples of tile, quartz and granite, flooring and hardware. Appointments are preferred, Saturday visits are by appointment, and customer parking is in front and along the west side of the building.

items.q: Do you handle design, or do I need my own designer?
items.a: MJ has its own design team. After an in-home measure you receive floor plans, elevation drawings and a written estimate, then you work with an interior designer on finishes and get color renderings of your selections. If you already have an interior designer or builder, MJ works with them too.

items.q: Will you take on a bathroom-only project?
items.a: Yes. The team remodels primary baths, guest and powder rooms, Jack-and-Jill layouts and high-traffic family bathrooms. Features it installs include curbless walk-in showers with Euro-style glass doors, freestanding soaking tubs, radiant-heat floors, built-in benches and vanities with pull-out storage for hair tools.

final_cta.text: Call the MJ team or book a free consultation at the Plymouth showroom on Ann Arbor Road.
